about_title:
Built by a fighter.
For those who are ready.
about_p1: 17 years in martial arts and physical conditioning. From a gym coach to the creator of a system that develops people — not just gives them a workout.
about_p2: Hundreds of students have trained with us: beginners who became confident, athletes who became champions, coaches who now run their own gyms.
about_p3: I've stepped into the cage myself — lost, won, recovered from injuries, and came back stronger. That's why our club isn't about "training for photos." It's about discipline, character, and growth.
about_feat3_desc: Tailored for injuries, age, and limitations
about_quote: "The club is an extension of me. My values. My approach to work."
method_desc: Everyone understands: why they train, where they're heading, what's next
method_step1_desc: We assess your current physical condition, identify limitations, and build a plan. We prepare your body for training — no burnout.
method_step2_desc: A gentle start: technique, foundational movements, strengthening weak areas. No injuries, no overload.
method_step3_desc: Gradual progression: more technique, strength, and endurance. Every session is a step forward.
method_step4_desc: A confident body, stable skills, a habit of training. Your body supports your life, not hinders it.
gallery_desc: Real workouts, real people, real results

results_m1_l1: Your body adapts to the load, stiffness goes away
results_m1_l4: Confidence in the gym — understanding how things work
results_m2_l1: Strength and endurance grow — visible body changes
results_m2_l3: Less stress, better sleep and mood
results_m3_l4: You are a different person. Inside and out
rehab_desc: We help recover from injuries, eliminate chronic pain, and restore mobility
rehab_lead: Many come to us not for fighting, but for recovery. Back, knees, shoulders — we address real problems, not just "pump muscles." Our proprietary method combines movement, control, and strengthening.
rehab_offer_author_desc: Personal guidance focused on recovery and solving a specific problem

reviews_desc: Real stories from people who transformed their body and life
review1_text: "I came in with a bad back, thinking I'd just 'work out.' Within 2 months, my back stopped hurting and I picked up boxing. Now I train 4 times a week."
review2_text: "I'd never done martial arts. I was afraid it would be intimidating. Turns out, the atmosphere is like family. In 3 months I lost 8 kg and gained real confidence."
review3_text: "I'd trained at 5 gyms before this one. Here, I finally feel a real system — every session is logical, every step is clear. I see progress every single week."
